results.title: Verifying state shown during article verification pipeline

steps.title: Given an analysis whose article verification pipeline is actively running
When the Actions Center is opened while verification is still in progress
Then a verifying sources state indicator is displayed instead of the source list

results.notes: SKIP — Backend-only precondition: requires an analysis whose article verification pipeline is actively running server-side. The current Toyota/staging dataset has already completed verification (167 sources visible in the Actions Center). This intermediate verifying state cannot be triggered or observed via UI. A dedicated test environment with a fresh, uncached analysis would be needed to observe this state.

results.title: Source list appears without reload after verification completes

steps.title: Given the Actions Center is open and showing the verifying sources state
When the article verification pipeline completes
Then the Target Sources list appears automatically without requiring a page reload

results.notes: SKIP — Multi-state/timing dependency: requires observing the transition from verifying state to sources list state in real time, which itself depends on TC-001 precondition (active pipeline). Additionally, this is a backend event (pipeline completion) that cannot be triggered or timed from the UI. Both the initial state and the transition event are inaccessible via MCP browser automation.
